M-SCROLL-VIEW-WIDGET.Purpose: Native IMGUI scroll viewport coordinating mutable scroll position, child-space transforms and rectangular clipped child rendering.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: ScrollView horizontal/vertical native scroll state, viewport rect and content extents.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: OnScroll notifications, Tooltip and optional background/border drawing.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Geometry/hit testing and viewport clip calculation — owned by M-TRANSFORM-SERVICE and M-CLIP-SERVICE.

Requirements.REQ-001: GetChildrenTransform translates descendants by negative ScrollPosition; BeginScrollView already applies the native scroll translation while drawing, so WidgetRenderer must not apply it a second time.
Requirements.REQ-002: The viewport is the published padding box supplied explicitly by WidgetRenderer; scrolled descendants are clipped and hit-tested against that same rect.
Requirements.REQ-003: Native scroll view caches viewport/content geometry across unchanged layout and updates cached rects when layout or viewport changes.
Requirements.REQ-004: OnScroll reports native ScrollPosition changes; content extents account for child layout bounds and trailing padding.

Inputs.IN-001: Children, scroll axis Props, native wheel/scrollbar input and host Rect.

Outputs.OUT-001: Current ScrollPosition as a child-space Matrix4x4 and clipped native viewport.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Opens/closes Widgets.BeginScrollView/EndScrollView and mutates owned ScrollPosition State.
